query: SELECT input.provider_model_id AS "provider_model_id!" FROM unnest($1::uuid[]) AS input(provider_model_id) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM providers p JOIN provider_revision_models prm ON prm.provider_revision_id = p.active_revision_id WHERE prm.source_provider_model_id = input.provider_model_id AND prm.enabled AND p.state <> 'disabled'::provider_state ) LIMIT 1
